requires: Owner approval on 2026-11-06; exact word counts recorded, synthetic tests and leakage audit passing, and SHA-256 recorded in the run script before any EEG feature is fitted
question: On held-out list blocks, does EEG locked to each fixated word predict word meaning well enough to tell sentences apart within a block, beyond matched noise, shuffled pairs, gaze and word properties, and list position?

sources.files: Existing local results*_NR.mat files for 12 ZuCo 1.0 and 18 ZuCo 2.0 readers, opened read-only, hashes checked
sources.cache_policy: Word rows are written to a new versioned folder; no existing dataset, cache or result is changed
sources.pairing: Word index joins each word record to the token at that position in the manifest sentence; the run stops if a sentence's word count differs from its token count

protected.policy: v1 test sentences, v2 test blocks and their buffers are never fitted or scored. Their word fields are discarded on read without being stored, because the source files are streams; their word records are skipped where the format allows. A run-time audit refuses to continue otherwise

folds.source: The same 13 held-out blocks as averaged-EEG test v5, with 10 list positions of buffer on each side

targets.word_training_target: New: all-MiniLM-L6-v2 embedding of each token, lowercased with edge punctuation removed, in a new separate cache at the pinned revision
targets.primary_candidate: New: mean of the candidate sentence's token embeddings, over all its tokens
targets.secondary_candidate: Unchanged MiniLM sentence embedding from the existing text cache

primary.features: Supplied TRT word features: 8 bands by 104 channels with Cz removed, 832 values, using log1p of the supplied amplitude
primary.usable_word: All 832 values finite; words with no finite vector are not fixated and contribute no row

secondary_waveform.features: Raw first-fixation snippet with Cz removed: mean amplitude in 50 ms bins up to 300 ms, 104 channels by 6 bins, 624 values; bins past the end of a fixation are 0 after scaling

reader_scaling: Z-scored per reader and fold, using that reader's training word rows only

model.type: Ridge from word features to word embedding; no word text is an input
model.alpha_selection: Inside each fold's training data only: one seeded contiguous 25-position block per release plus 10 positions each side are held back, scored with the primary metric, then the model is refit on all of that fold's training word rows

sentence_prediction.word_slot: Mean prediction across the readers who fixated that word in that sentence
sentence_prediction.sentence: Mean over the sentence's fixated word slots
sentence_prediction.subset_draws: Mean score over 20 seeded reader subsets per sentence for counts below all

arms.gaussian: Matched noise per word: the mean of that observation's word vectors plus Gaussian noise, with each feature's spread taken from that reader's within-observation variation in training rows. Keeps observation-level amplitude, fixation pattern and row count, and removes word-specific EEG
arms.class_shuffled: Training sentences' word targets permuted by sentence within release, keeping each sentence's token count where possible, mean of 10 shuffles
arms.gaze_word: Ridge with no EEG on token length, log training frequency of the token, TRT duration, number of fixations, word position, sentence word count and release flag

position.input: Release flag and Fourier basis of list position; no EEG

arms.partial: Inside each held-out block, remove from real and noise sentence predictions what list position, its square, word count, mean TRT duration and fixated-word count explain linearly. Refits nothing

evaluation.primary: Expected 10-way top-1 within each query's own held-out block against primary candidates, all readers averaged, equal weight per sentence, ties are misses; chance 10%
secondary: Score against reader count for real and noise; one reader is the closest to real single-recording use
Expected 2-way, 4-way, 10-way and 24-way against all scored sentences in the release
Direct word test: expected 10-way among each block's unique word types, for real, noise and gaze_word
Share of held-out tokens whose word type occurs in that fold's training data
First-fixation waveform input, real and noise
New readers: seeded half of each release's readers for fitting, the other half for scoring, on the same held-out blocks; real, noise and shuffled
evaluation.scoring: Every N-way score subtracts the pool mean from predictions and from candidates before cosine, so a candidate close to the average sentence cannot win for every query. The same applies inside alpha selection

decision_rule.bootstrap: 10000 resamples of sentences and of blocks; 2000 of readers within release, recomputing the average, for gaussian and class_shuffled. Two-sided 95% intervals
decision_rule.clear: Gap at least the minimum and every available lower bound above 0

outcomes.condition: Beats nulls, and gaze_word, position and partial all clear
outcomes.label: Word-locked EEG carries sentence information beyond the controls

outcomes.condition: Beats nulls, and gaze_word, position or partial does not clear
outcomes.label: The gain does not exceed gaze, word properties or position
No sentence signal found with word-locked features

decision_rule.secondary_scope: Secondary results never change the label

refuse_if: A protected sentence reaches a stored row, fit or score
A held-out sentence key, sentence group or signal file appears in that fold's training
A training sentence is within 10 list positions of the fold's block in the same release
Token Jaccard at least 0.7, token containment at least 0.8 or text cosine at least 0.9 across a fold boundary
A word's text, eye-tracking values or word boxes enter an EEG arm's features
Scaling statistics use a held-out row
tests_before_run: A planted word-meaning signal is recovered, and improves with reader count
Noise with no signal stays at chance at every reader count
Signals carrying only list position, word length, frequency or fixation duration do not earn the first reading, checked over 20 seeds each
A signal present only at sentence level, shared by all a sentence's words, is not counted as word-locked by the noise arm
audit.false_pass_check: On synthetic fixtures before freezing: position-only, length-only, frequency-only and duration-only signals each earned the first reading on 0 of 20 seeds; planted word signals earned it on the seeds checked, and a sentence-level signal did not

test_policy: No final test data is scored. Any later confirmation on the v2 test blocks needs a new plan and the owner's decision
stop_rule: Stop after this run whatever the outcome. No extra settings or models under this plan.
existing_output_policy: Refuse to run if the output directory exists; hash protected prior artifacts before and after
